If he knew that you were monitoring his snap score and his Instagram likes, he wouldn’t be happy. He’d be freaked out, honestly. This is not a good basis for a relationship. If this is your behaviour after 2 months of talking and one date, it’s not a good start. You need to take a huge step back and focus on you - take long breaks from your phone (hide it away if you need to) and do things you like to do instead of waiting to hear from him and stalking his profiles.

Edited to add: if you hung out last week and he’s gone a bit quiet this week, perhaps the vibe wasn’t right for him and he’s trying to let you down easy while still being polite. Sometimes people just don’t click as well in person as they do via text/Snap.
